title: new_factory batch plan
description: The one interface between new-ba and the new factory. new-ba writes it into the epic's body under '## Plan' and keeps a local copy; check-batch.mjs builds it from the tickets and validates it against this file. A draft plan (before the issues exist) names tickets by key (T1) and has no epic; a published plan has epic, repo and an issue number on every ticket.

id.description: Short name of the batch, e.g. todo-v1. Also the prototype's folder name.

epic.description: Issue number of the epic that holds this plan.

hash.description: planHash() in scripts/lib.mjs over each ticket's wave, owns, uses, dependsOn, newDependencies and criteria (id and text) as the issue bodies say them. Equal hash: the tickets are as check-batch passed them.

waveLimitReason.description: Present only when the batch has more than 3 waves: why the code could not be split further. check-batch refuses more than 3 waves without it.

layout.description: pages-features: the repository had no code when the batch was written (scripts/detect-layout.mjs), so the batch lays it out as src/app, src/shared, src/pages/<page>/features/<feature>, src/features/<feature>, e2e/<page>/<feature> (references/slicing.md). existing: the repository has code; its own structure, names and test locations are followed and nothing about structure changes.

command.description: The shell command, run from the repository root.

checks.description: The commands the factory runs as the project's checks. Existing repository: read from package.json, CI or its docs. New repository: the commands the foundation ticket makes work, each with a foundation criterion.

stack.description: One line: language, framework, test runners.

shared.description: Files several slices would want to change (routes, store, schema, App, config). Each is owned by at most one ticket per wave.

extensionPoint.description: How a slice plugs in without touching shared files, e.g. src/features/*/index.ts picked up by a registry. Empty string when there is none.

name.description: What tickets list under Uses. A slot is named slot:<name>.

summary.description: The exact shape: names, signatures, data, behaviour. The ticket that provides it states the same in its criteria. After wave 0 the file is append-only: later tickets add to it, never change what is there.

prototype.description: The approved prototype of the whole flow. The factory copies `git archive <commit>` of the branch into `path` once, when it prepares the batch.

path.description: Folder in the repository, ending in /, holding index.html.

wave.description: Wave 0 is the foundation when there are later waves. Waves run in order; tickets of one wave run in parallel.

ref.anyOfMessage: is an issue number, or T<n> in a draft

ticket.anyOfMessage: a ticket has an issue number, or a key (T1) in a draft

key.description: The ticket's name before it had a number; kept for tracing.

owns.description: Globs of the only files this ticket may change or create. A folder is written dir/**.

uses.description: Names of architecture.contracts this ticket builds on.

dependsOn.description: Tickets of earlier waves this one needs merged first.

newDependencies.description: Packages this ticket needs installed, name@version, from its 'New dependencies' section ([] for none). The factory adds the union to package.json and installs it once before building; no slice owns package.json (a new repository's foundation owns it for its scripts and settings only). Two tickets naming one package name it at the same version.

criteria.description: Criterion ids, unique across the batch.
